units.source_text: 女子站起身来，在廊道的昏暗中平静地消失了。

en.t: The woman rose to her feet and quietly disappeared into the dimness of the corridor.

units.source_text: 良久，女子端着茶碗，折了回来，微风吹拂着她的长和服袖子。

en.t: After a long while, the woman came back carrying a tea bowl, while a faint breeze stirred the long sleeves of her kimono.
She offered the tea to the man before her.

units.source_text: 按茶道的礼法功过淡菜以后，她又回到原来的地方跪坐下来。

en.t: After completing the tea ceremony formalities according to the rules of tea practice, she returned to her original place and knelt down again.

units.source_text: 男子似乎说了些什么，却怎么也不呷一口茶。

en.t: The man seemed to say something, but he would not take even a sip of the tea.

units.source_text: 这段时间令人感到异样的长，异样的紧张。

en.t: That stretch of time felt strangely long and strangely tense.
The woman lowered her head deeply...
